blocks.text: 我们正在通过一项新协议扩大与总务管理局（GSA）的合作，该协议为政府合作伙伴提供 Claude Enterprise、Claude for Government 和 Claude API 的 40% 折扣。这是该折扣首次覆盖所有产品形态，包括各机构目前直接从我们这里购买，以及未来几个月通过云服务提供商购买的情况。该折扣还扩展至州、地方、部落和领地政府。

blocks.text: 我们同时启动一项专门计划，帮助各机构实施并充分利用 Claude。这类计划通常被我们的私营部门客户所采用，我们期待在未来几周将这些最佳实践带给我们的公共部门合作伙伴。

blocks.text: 目前约有 500 个美国联邦、州和地方政府机构使用 Claude。自 2 月以来，Claude for Government 的周活跃用户增长了约八倍，联邦文职机构的使用量在一年内增长了约 20 倍。这些机构运行着美国一些最重要的系统，通常预算紧张且采购周期漫长。该协议旨在支持这项工作，使他们能够将 Claude 应用于棘手问题，而无需大额前期投入。

blocks.text: We are expanding our partnership with the General Services Administration (GSA) through a new agreement that gives government partners a 40% discount on Claude Enterprise, Claude for Government, and the Claude API. For the first time, the discount applies across every product surface, including when agencies buy from us directly today and through cloud providers in the coming months. The discount also extends to state, local, tribal and territorial governments.

inlines.text: We are expanding our partnership with the General Services Administration (GSA) through a new agreement that gives government partners a 40% discount on Claude Enterprise, Claude for Government, and the Claude API. For the first time, the discount applies across every product surface, including when agencies buy from us directly today and through cloud providers in the coming months. The discount also extends to state, local, tribal and territorial governments.

blocks.text: We are also launching a dedicated program to help agencies implement and make the most of their Claude use. These programs are commonly leveraged by our private sector customers and we’re looking forward to bringing those best practices to our public sector partners in the coming weeks.

blocks.text: Approximately 500 US federal, state, and local government organizations now use Claude. Weekly Claude for Government active users are up about eightfold since February, and usage across federal civilian agencies has grown about 20-fold in a year. Those organizations run some of the most important systems in the country, usually on tight budgets and with long procurement cycles. This agreement is built to support that work, so they can apply Claude to hard problems without a large upfront commitment.

blocks.text: Government agencies are using Claude to solve some of their most important challenges. Examples include managing backlogs, records and forms, and modernizing old code. Some of the ways agencies are using Claude include:

inlines.text: Government agencies are using Claude to solve some of their most important challenges. Examples include managing backlogs, records and forms, and modernizing old code. Some of the ways agencies are using Claude include:
Utah gave Claude Code to 34 developers across 10 state agencies. 80% had a working environment within 30 minutes, 71% reported saving 20+ hours by the end of the four-week pilot.
A US state CIO confirmed their team was able to respond to a ransomware attack in 8 minutes vs. the usual 2-3 days thanks to Claude.

A US federal security team used Claude Mythos to detect and patch the vulnerability that would have allowed for the takeover of a critical production system in about two days. A human penetration test the month before had missed it.
A cybersecurity professional at a major agency found and patched bugs in critical financial systems.
A US state IT developer moved nearly 900 API methods to a new framework in two days. The project had been scoped for a month.
A US state IT director used Claude Code to document 12 legacy code repositories, mapping 467 database tables and flagging 27 risks along the way.
More than half of the US states, some of the largest localities, and some of the countries largest critical infrastructure operators
participated
in our SLTT cyber defense program.
